name: journal_context_immutability_reversal_integrity
preconditionSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT version FROM public.schema_migrations ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)='0034'
  AND to_regclass('public.journal_entry_seals') IS NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_line_snapshot(uuid)') IS NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_entry_seal_at_commit()') IS NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_entry_insert_guard()') IS NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_line_insert_guard()') IS NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_line_seal_validate()') IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
              WHERE t.tgrelid='public.journal_lines'::regclass
                AND t.tgname='ct_journal_entries__balanced_at_commit'
                AND t.tgdeferrable AND t.tginitdeferred
                AND NOT t.tgisinternal)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entries)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_lines)
  AS ok;
verificationSql:
SELECT
  to_regclass('public.journal_entry_seals') IS NOT NULL
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
         WHERE attrelid='public.journal_entry_seals'::regclass
           AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped)=4
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint
         WHERE conrelid='public.journal_entry_seals'::regclass
           AND conname IN ('pk_journal_entry_seals',
                           'fk_journal_entry_seals__entry',
                           'ck_journal_entry_seals__nonempty',
                           'ck_journal_entry_seals__snapshot'))=4
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_index
         WHERE indrelid='public.journal_entry_seals'::regclass)=1
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_line_snapshot(uuid)') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_seal_write_guard()') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_entry_insert_guard()') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_history_immutable()') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_batch_immutable()') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_line_insert_guard()') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_entry_seal_at_commit()') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_journal_line_seal_validate()') IS NOT NULL
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
        WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled IN ('O','A')
          AND t.tgname IN (
          'bt_journal_entry_seals__write_guard',
          'bt_journal_entries__insert_context','bt_journal_entries__immutable',
          'bt_journal_lines__immutable','bt_posting_batches__journal_immutable',
          'bt_journal_lines__insert_context',
          'ct_journal_entries__seal_at_commit','ct_journal_lines__seal_validate'
          ))=8
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
        WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgdeferrable AND t.tginitdeferred
          AND t.tgname IN ('ct_journal_entries__seal_at_commit',
                           'ct_journal_lines__seal_validate',
                           'ct_journal_entries__balanced_at_commit'))=3
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.journal_entries) =
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.journal_entry_seals)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entry_seals s
     WHERE s.line_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM public.fn_journal_line_snapshot(s.entry_id)
       OR s.line_count IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(public.fn_journal_line_snapshot(s.entry_id))
  )
  AS ok;
recovery: 0035 is atomic and forward-only. Any failed precondition, DDL, or COMMIT rolls back the seal relation, triggers, functions and migration history. Reject ALL pre-existing Journal entries; NO silent data backfill. For populated targets require read-only preflight, verified backup and a separately approved reconciliation migration. After a committed 0035 only a NEW forward migration can repair it. Never touch Convex/production or rewrite 0009/0019/0034.
